title: IVTFuse: An Efficient Vision-Language Guided Infrared-Visible Image Fusion Network with Frequency-Strip and Hybrid Pooling Attention Modules

contributions.purpose: 让文本语义直接引导红外-可见光图像融合
contributions.mechanism: 三分支(IR/VIS/文本)网络,BLIP 文本嵌入经双交叉注意力+文本引导通道重加权注入 3 级层次化融合块,Restormer 解码重建
contributions.evaluation: VLF 基准三数据集(MSRS/M3FD/RoadScene)对 10 个 SOTA 基线,EN/SF/AG/VIF/Qabf 多指标最优或次优(MSRS 上 EN 6.73/VIF 1.09/Qabf 0.75 居首)
contributions.domain: 红外-可见光图像融合(计算机视觉)
contributions.source_quote: We propose IVTFuse, a novel vision-language-guided infrared-visible image fusion architecture. Unlike previous fusion methods, our tri-modal design fuses IR, VIS, and text features within a unified network.

contributions.purpose: 以轻量注意力模块增强各模态特征提取
contributions.mechanism: FSA 按水平/垂直条带分解高低频并可学习重组;HPA 分组混合平均/最大池化做空间注意力
contributions.evaluation: RoadScene 消融(3 seeds):去两模块最差,HPA 单独使 SD 45.44→48.57,FSA 使 VIF 0.49→0.58,全模型 EN 7.46/AG 6.77 全面最优
contributions.source_quote: We introduce two new lightweight attention modules, Frequency Strip Attention (FSA) and Hybrid Pooling Attention (HPA), to enhance modality-specific feature extraction.

contributions.purpose: 证明多模态引导融合达到 SOTA 且保持紧凑模型
contributions.mechanism: 与 FILM 等 10 个近期方法在统一测试图像上定量+可视对比,并报模型复杂度
contributions.evaluation: 2.08M 参数(FILM 2.07M),推理 130.14ms vs FILM 72.90ms(慢约 1.8 倍),以速度换质量;随机文本消融显示错误 caption 使全指标下降
contributions.source_quote: Extensive experiments on three public IR-VIS fusion benchmarks demonstrate that IVTFuse outperforms a wide range of state-of-the-art methods.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Like FILM [31], we leverage a vision-language model to provide semantic guidance, but our method does so without requiring lengthy intermediate captions or separate optimization stages.
Drawing on the dual-domain strip attention idea [14], FSA separates each feature map into low-frequency and high-frequency content along two orthogonal orientations.
We follow the standard setup used in [7] and adopt its text annotation pipeline without modification.
Our architecture is built on efficient Restormer-based transformers and maintains a compact model size.

notes: 本批唯一 accept,也是唯一有完整实证的 ML 论文,四元组适配良好,有编号贡献列表(3 条)。trade-off:推理 130.14ms vs FILM 72.90ms(慢 1.8 倍),作者以融合质量提升为由辩护;负结果:随机文本消融(Exp.IV)显示 caption 错配时全指标显著下降(如 EN 7.46→7.17),自承对噪声/对抗性 caption 脆弱。GPT-4o 被列为第一作者;Reproducibility Statement 声明 ChatGPT-4o 生成全部研究叙事、人类做实验并验证,公开完整对话链接。AI 参与度:假设[D]、写作[D]、实验/分析[C];Observed AI Limitations 自承 AI 无法独立完成研究,每步需人类具体指令。消融报 3 seeds 方差,但主表(Table 1)无 error bars。
